title: Jubilant Charred American Pine Nut Hash
description: A charred, crisp, plant-based American dish featuring pine nuts, perfect for a brunch mood, served on a wooden board.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, apple cider vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced red onion, red bell pepper, and portobello mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Spread the marinated vegetables on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 25 minutes.
While the vegetables are roasting, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pine nuts to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until charred and fragrant, about 5 minutes.
Remove the vegetables from the oven and add them to the skillet with the pine nuts.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the hash is crispy and golden brown.
Transfer the hash to a wooden board and serve immediately.
